text.KJV NEH 7:13: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.

A.name: Elam
A.line: his sons (descendants) returned to Judah after captivity (EZR 2:7)
A.notes: father of Jehiel (EZR 10:2), named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:14)
family: ancestor-of jeshaiah-3 (Jeshaiah, descendant of Elam, son of Athaliah who went up with Ezra (E)
descendant-of jacob (Jacob, second-born son of Isaac (GEN 25:25-26))

B.name: Elam
B.line: Ancestor of 1,254 exiles who returned with Zerubbabel

why: בְּנֵי עֵילָם appears between Pahath-moab and Zattu, matching the Ezra 2:7 family explicitly identified with A. The count of 1,254 also fits B, so the list position, rather than the number, decides it.
